how_to_reach: Dharmapuri Kshetram is well-connected by road and accessible from major cities across Telangana and Andhra Pradesh.
TGRTC and various private operators run regular buses to Dharmapuri from all major cities of Telangana and Andhra Pradesh.
The fastest way to reach the temple is by your own vehicle (car or private taxi).
Daily TGRTC Rajadhani A/C bus service operates from Hyderabad MGBS to Dharmapuri Kshetram at 11:00 PM, returning from Dharmapuri at 11:30 PM.

nearest_railway_station.name: Mancherial Railway Station
nearest_railway_station.connectivity: Major railway hub connecting regional and national routes

nearest_airport.name: Hyderabad Airport (Rajiv Gandhi International Airport)
nearest_airport.connectivity: Well connected to all major cities of India and abroad. Other close airports include Nagpur Airport (330 km) and Vijayawada Airport (390 km).

bus_routes: TGRTC Rajadhani A/C daily service: Hyderabad MGBS to Dharmapuri Kshetram at 11:00 PM; Return from Dharmapuri at 11:30 PM.
Regular TGRTC and private buses connecting Dharmapuri with Jagtial, Hyderabad, and major cities across Telangana and Andhra Pradesh.
road_routes: Jagtial-Dharmapuri Main Road into Dharmapuri town.
Accessible by private car or taxi via major highway networks in Telangana.
parking_info: Use designated parking areas and follow local traffic and police instructions.
During festivals and other high-crowd periods, temporary traffic and parking arrangements may be introduced.
Parking availability and access restrictions can change during major festivals, so visitors should follow current on-site instructions.
